unchanged: Macro disabled has the same preprocessed HDL tokens as the pre-runtime native HDMI composition. HDMI clocks/timing/reset domains, BIST, scanout, DDR arbiter/client ownership and ready policy remain unchanged.
remaining: Explicit future source/profile selection, full composition timing/CDC/resources and board acceptance. DDR/video reset-domain separation is not implemented; platform fail-stop guard must own fault handling.
runtime_changes: Optional atomic completed-frame display pipeline; independent export; raster/P5-commit lease for idle-only cache publication; current-context raster gate; DDR reset/ready observation ports only
